title: Fukuman no hitozuma: Otoko o tatasu hôsoku
original_title: 福まんの人妻　男を立たす法則
overview: Kazue is constantly troubled by her penniless, good-for-nothing husband and her slovenly daughter. However, her life—and the destinies of her family and a young man named Takumi whom she meets—begin to change after she wins 100 million yen in the lottery.
